title: Vnish Global: verify a firmware catalog record
description:
https://vnish.global/data/

A factual walkthrough of the public Vnish Global firmware catalog: exact model and board routing, release metadata, SHA-256 and byte-size correspondence. A match confirms correspondence with one catalog record only; it is not a security audit or installation approval.

Evidence record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21992016
visual_provenance: Public-page screen captures with editorial text overlays
